faqs.question: What is the minimum order quantity (MOQ) and tooling cost for FS-084 Multi-Stage Tactical Armor Carbon-Inlay Mechanical EDC?
faqs.answer: Because FS-084 utilizes our mature ready-to-use production mold (#84), the tooling and mold fee is $0.00. The wholesale MOQ is 50 pcs for blank stock orders and 100 pcs for custom 50W Fiber Laser Engraved or Deep Laser + Color Fill logo orders.

faqs.question: Can we customize our corporate or brand logo on FS-084?
faqs.answer: Yes. Note that our factory does NOT recommend surface silk-screen or UV ink printing on metal because smooth, chemically inert metal surfaces lack ink adhesion and peel off under thumb friction. Instead, we recommend two permanent methods on FS-084: (1) 50W Fiber Laser Engraving for monochrome logos (+$0.15–$0.30/pc, $0 setup, 100 pcs MOQ, $50 USD sample fee), and (2) Deep Laser Engraving + Color Fill for colored logos (+$0.35–$0.60/pc, 100–200 pcs MOQ, $80–$150 USD sample fee), where the laser carves a recessed cavity filled with cured enamel so the color never peels.
